legend: Skin biopsy at the mosquito bite site showing epidermal necrosis and ulceration, with lymphocytic infiltrate in the dermis (<<31106>>). The dermal infiltrate consists of small to medium-sized atypical lymphoid cells (<<30497>>). The infiltrating lymphocytes are positive for TIA1 (<<30498>>). In situ hybridization for EBV-encoded small RNA (EBER) highlights the atypical cells (<<30499>>).
source: Yuta Tsuyuki(Department of Pathology and Laboratory Medicine, Nagoya University Hospital, Nagoya, Japan).
